text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and Stock E at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should base trades on my plan and each holding’s role in the portfolio.","The account’s decline is uncomfortable, but neither a loss nor my average cost tells me what a stock will do next. I should avoid holding merely to dodge admitting a mistake.","Since price changes are unpredictable and I trade infrequently, I should ignore short-term swings and act only when evidence, risk limits, or my target allocation gives me a clear reason."]}
